# 1 Enoch Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**19:1** And Uriel said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who-have-mingled with the women, and their spirits — having-assumed many-different forms — are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into offering-sacrifices to demons as unto gods, [here shall they stand] until the great day of judgment in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of."

**19:2** "And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens."

**19:3** And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things; and no man shall see as I have seen.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text. Ch. 19 is brief (3 verses). "Sirens" (Ge'ez siren) is a loanword from Greek Σειρήν, retained. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive for this chapter, significant variants are noted.*
